description: Skelet G09-09 source-linked style evidence and capture-to-report wiring

state.change: New pure style-evidence module (43-property computed allowlist mirroring the extractor contract, 32-element/1500-declaration budgets, deterministic ASCII refs), offline capture collects bounded computed-style snapshots with scripts disabled and remote resources blocked, worker IPC validates declarations fail-closed including sparse arrays, report gains assembleLensReportFromCapture with capture-computed-styles provenance; caller-supplied path unchanged.

correctness.instructions: Any lost style evidence, wrong token attribution, broken provenance basis, or regressed G09-08 report contract?

security.instructions: Any executed page content, unbounded input, XSS/CSS re-emission, fabricated rights, or weakened capture isolation in the new evidence path?

evidence.instructions: Are the new tests sufficient for allowlist filtering, budgets, hostile values, sparse arrays, offline capture attachment, and both report paths?

reliability.instructions: Any nondeterminism across OS, browser versions, element ordering, or ref construction in the evidence pipeline?

scope.instructions: Anything beyond G09-09 source-linked style evidence and capture/report wiring, before exports and provider integration?

compatibility.instructions: Could the new CaptureResult declarations field or report validator change regress an existing P09 contract or consumer?
